name: TOB Blessing Verse
description: A small, hand-curated bank of encouraging/blessing verse REFERENCES — deliberately never stores verse text itself, matching this app's standing rule that Scripture text lives only in the Flutter client's own on-device SQLite Bible (see HANDOFF.md §5.7). The client resolves the actual verse text locally, in whatever language/version it already has installed, from bible_book/chapter/verse_start/verse_end. Used by two features: the Daily Verse screen (verse card, no AI involved) and the AI daily_devotional task (this reference is passed in as the anchor the AI writes its reflection around — the AI never invents which verse to use). System-Manager-only permissions, same as every other Bible Battle/content doctype in this app — read only through whitelisted API methods.
